title: Evidence Terms for Delivery Claims Customers
content:
These Delivery Claims terms set out the evidence a customer's claim must carry before it is decided, the deadline for that evidence, the value thresholds for a signed declaration and a police report, and how long a damaged item is kept.

## Evidence by claim type

| Claim type | Evidence that must be on the claim before decision | Deadline for evidence (calendar days after opening) | Signed non-receipt declaration required at a claimed value of | Police report reference required at a claimed value of | Carrier-captured signature at delivery leads to denial unless a police report is on the claim | Damaged item and packaging kept for (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Late Delivery Claim | none | 7 | 0.00 (never) | 0.00 (never) | no | 0 (not applicable) |
| Delivered Not Received Claim | neighbour check confirmation | 7 | 200.00 USD or more | 1000.00 USD or more | yes | 0 (not applicable) |
| Lost in Transit Claim | none | 7 | 0.00 (never) | 0.00 (never) | no | 0 (not applicable) |
| Damaged in Transit Claim | damage photos and packaging photos | 7 | 0.00 (never) | 0.00 (never) | no | 14 |
| Missing Item Claim | packaging photos | 7 | 0.00 (never) | 0.00 (never) | no | 0 (not applicable) |
| Wrong Item Claim | wrong item photo | 7 | 0.00 (never) | 0.00 (never) | no | 0 (not applicable) |

A threshold of 0.00 means the document is never required for that type.

## What the thresholds mean for a Delivered Not Received Claim

- Claimed value below 200.00 USD: the neighbour check confirmation is the required evidence.
- Claimed value of 200.00 USD up to but not including 1000.00 USD: the customer's signed non-receipt declaration is required as well.
- Claimed value of 1000.00 USD or more: the signed declaration and a police report reference are both required.
- Hypothetical cases: a claimed value of exactly 200.00 USD requires the declaration; 199.99 USD does not. A claimed value of exactly 1000.00 USD requires the police report reference; 999.99 USD does not.

## Damaged items

A customer with a Damaged in Transit Claim keeps the damaged item and its packaging for 14 calendar days for possible carrier inspection. No other claim type carries this term.
